values.question: Which lipid features differ between the left and right regions of the demo slide?

data.manualRoute: No step. The Analyze tab shows the same list of analyses.

analyses.name: Find spatial features
analyses.help: Spatially-aware peak detection (S/N → reproducibility → Moran's I denoise). Produces the working feature set later steps use.

analyses.name: Coherent feature extraction
analyses.help: Spatial feature detection (S/N → reproducibility → Moran's I) plus an artifact-rejection quality gate (spatial-chaos morphology + hotspot concentration) that screens out delocalization / matrix-crystal ions which pass autocorrelation but aren't real. Produces a working feature set.

analyses.name: Find peaks
analyses.help: Detect peaks in the mean spectrum (S/N + prominence). Produces the working feature set.

analyses.name: Segmentation
analyses.help: Cluster pixels into regions. 0 clusters = auto-pick by silhouette.

analyses.name: Lipizones (hierarchical lipid territories)
analyses.help: Split the tissue into a tree of lipid territories (lipizones), with the mouse-brain lipid atlas' own method (EUCLID) or a lighter bisection. Shows every pixel as a dot coloured by lipizone, with a t-SNE inset.

analyses.name: Region comparison (A vs B)
analyses.help: Per-ion comparison of two groups (AUC + fold-change + test). Each named sub-ROI is a replicate.

analyses.name: Region spectra (A vs B overlay)
analyses.help: Overlay two regions' whole mean spectra (or their difference) — the visual companion to Region comparison (A vs B). Toggle overlay ⇄ difference in the result.

analyses.name: Lipid class comparison (A vs B)
analyses.help: Roll the per-ion identifications up to whole lipid classes (PE, PC, SM, …) and compare two groups: each class's summed signal gets the same exact rank-based AUC + fold-change + test as the per-ion Region comparison. Identification mode/tolerance set how peaks map to classes.

analyses.name: Lipid class composition (A vs B)
analyses.help: Each group's lipid-class composition: the share (%) of annotated-lipid signal in every class, for group A and group B side by side (each column sums to 100%). Identification mode/tolerance set how peaks map to classes.

analyses.name: Region marker panel
analyses.help: Sweep several region pairs (each sub-region vs its parent by default), keep every pair's AUC-distinctive ions, and merge them into ONE feature list for downstream analyses. Click 'Auto-pair sub→parent' to pair each sub-ROI with its parent region, or 'Add pair…' to build A-vs-B pairs by hand. Per-pixel AUC effect size for candidate selection — follow with a Region comparison / cohort step for replicate-level p-values.

analyses.name: Discriminating features (per group)
analyses.help: Characteristic ions for each group vs the rest (one-vs-rest AUC + FDR). With exactly two tagged groups this is A-vs-B. Keep only the enriched, significant markers, save them as a per-group ★ list, and pass the survivors to the next step (e.g. a Venn). Ungrouped/background pixels are excluded from 'the rest'.

analyses.name: Multi-group features
analyses.help: Per-ion test across 3+ groups (Kruskal-Wallis or ANOVA).

analyses.name: ROI localization
analyses.help: How confined each ion is to the first group's ROI vs the rest of the tissue (one group is enough).

analyses.name: Keep features by AUC
analyses.help: Trim the previous comparison's ions by ROC AUC and make the survivors the working feature set. AUC 0.5 = no discrimination; >0.5 = higher in group B; <0.5 = higher in group A (more confined to the first ROI). The exported table keeps every ion with a 'kept' flag, so you get both the untrimmed and trimmed lists. Add after a Region comparison (A vs B) or ROI localization step.

analyses.name: Markers (shrunken centroids)
analyses.help: Nearest shrunken centroids — automatic marker selection per group.

analyses.name: Per-ion segmentation (DGMM)
analyses.help: Spatially-aware Gaussian-mixture segmentation of a single ion image into intensity zones (background → bright).

analyses.name: Distinct & shared ions (Venn)
analyses.help: Partition ions by which groups they are present in (Venn compartments).

analyses.name: Co-localization with ion
analyses.help: Rank all ions by spatial similarity to a target m/z.

analyses.name: Co-localization modules
analyses.help: Group ions into co-localized modules by hierarchical clustering.

analyses.name: Region correlation & match
analyses.help: Molecular-fingerprint similarity of every named region to every other — a region×region heatmap plus each region's closest match (the old Region-match view).

analyses.name: PCA images
analyses.help: Principal-component score images + loadings.

analyses.name: NMF images
analyses.help: Non-negative matrix factorization (additive parts) score images + loadings.

analyses.name: PLS-DA / OPLS-DA
analyses.help: Supervised classification; ranks ions by VIP (variable importance).

analyses.name: Classifier cross-validation
analyses.help: Cross-validated accuracy + confusion matrix for the PLS-DA classifier. Uses leave-one-tissue-out folds when the slide has ≥2 detected tissue pieces, else stratified k-fold (the engine flags an optimistic, leakage-prone estimate).

analyses.name: Classifier prediction map
analyses.help: Fit the PLS-DA classifier, then paint every pixel with its predicted class — a class-label map over the whole slide.

analyses.name: SHAP biomarkers
analyses.help: Per-region biomarker ions ranked by SHAP importance (RandomForest + TreeExplainer); each ion's direction is the Spearman sign of intensity vs its SHAP value. Needs the optional 'shap' package.

analyses.name: 2-D embedding (UMAP/t-SNE)
analyses.help: 2-D pixel embedding + molecular-similarity tissue map.

analyses.name: Annotate lipids
analyses.help: Match the feature set to the lipid database (isotopes + adducts + confidence).

analyses.name: Group comparison (A vs B)
analyses.help: Compare two subject groups across the whole cohort: each sample is one replicate, so the per-ion test (fold-change + q) is across subjects — the statistically defensible answer that the single-slide Region comparison only approximates per-pixel.

analyses.name: Nested stats (subject × compartment)
analyses.help: Per-ion mixed model y ~ group * compartment + (1 | subject) across the cohort — the correct multi-group-across-subjects test when each subject contributes several compartments/regions.

analyses.name: Pooled embedding (UMAP/t-SNE)
analyses.help: One UMAP/t-SNE over every sample's pixels on a shared feature axis — see how samples and groups separate in molecular space across the cohort.

analyses.name: Joint segmentation (shared)
analyses.help: One segmentation tree learned jointly and applied to every sample, so the same cluster labels mean the same thing across slides.

analyses.name: Glycan profile (traits & enzyme flux per group)
analyses.help: Match the feature set to N-glycan compositions and summarise each group's glycan processing state: class fractions, trait indices and enzyme-flux ratios.

analyses.name: Glycan readouts (A vs B)
analyses.help: Compare every glycan readout (class fractions, trait indices, enzyme-flux ratios) between two groups with the same exact AUC + test as the Region comparison.
